templates.name: Crosscurrent Shear
templates.setup: Two opposed currents begin twisting the submarine out of its safe approach corridor.

stages.contact: Sonar shows the route bending faster than the charts predict.
stages.crisis: The vessel is dragged toward rock, ice, or unsafe depth.
stages.aftermath: The crew must regain the route before the next hazard arrives.

complications: A cargo restraint tears loose.
The sonar picture becomes unreliable.
The safest route costs additional fuel.
opportunities: The current exposes a hidden passage.
Debris in the flow contains useful salvage.
templates.reward: The crew preserves the route and may exploit the newly revealed passage.
templates.failure: The submarine is displaced, battered, and forced into a less favorable route.
templates.persistent: A failed correction leaves the next Navigation encounter at +1 DC.

templates.name: Icefall Collapse
templates.setup: A ceiling of stressed Europan ice fractures above the route.

stages.contact: Hairline cracks race across the overhead shelf.
stages.crisis: Tons of ice descend through the travel lane.
stages.aftermath: The submarine must clear trapped debris before propulsion overheats.

complications: A weapon mount is pinned.
A ballast intake clogs.
The collapse seals the return path.
opportunities: Freshly exposed ice contains recoverable minerals.
templates.reward: The crew escapes with an intact hull and a clearer map of the region.
templates.failure: Impact damage and blocked systems turn the route into a repair operation.
templates.persistent: The collapsed passage remains blocked on the campaign map until cleared.

templates.name: Thermal Plume
templates.setup: A volcanic vent cycle floods the route with heat, turbulence, and mineral-rich particulate.

stages.contact: Temperature alarms rise while visibility falls.
stages.crisis: Cooling, batteries, and navigation begin failing together.
stages.aftermath: The crew must vent heat and inspect damaged seals.

complications: The reactor load spikes.
Medical stores are threatened by heat.
A hot-current eddy pushes the vessel deeper.
opportunities: Thermal data improves future route prediction.
templates.reward: The submarine crosses cleanly and records valuable vent data.
templates.failure: Heat damage degrades a system and consumes emergency supplies.
templates.persistent: Until repaired, the affected system loses another 5% condition after each dangerous leg.

templates.name: Moving Pressure Front

approaches.label: Hold the hull and ballast together
Climb ahead of the pressure wave

templates.setup: A fast pressure transition moves through the trench like weather.

stages.contact: The hull begins speaking in unfamiliar knocks.
stages.crisis: Seals, ballast, and weak compartments fail in sequence.
stages.aftermath: The crew must stabilize the frame before hidden damage spreads.

complications: An old hull repair begins leaking.
A crew member is trapped behind a pressure door.
The front drives predators toward the submarine.
opportunities: The pressure scan reveals a safe deep corridor.
A successful brace proves a new hull procedure.
templates.reward: The vessel survives the front and gains a reliable deep-pressure profile.
templates.failure: The hull and one system suffer serious structural damage.
templates.persistent: Future pressure events at this location remember whether the crew reinforced or abandoned it.

templates.name: False Navigation Beacon
templates.setup: A trusted navigation beacon transmits correct codes from an impossible position.

stages.contact: The beacon offers a shorter route.
stages.crisis: Following it leads toward terrain absent from every chart.
stages.aftermath: The crew must decide whether to expose, disable, or exploit the transmitter.

complications: The signal mimics a friendly station.
A second vessel is already following it.
The beacon contains a delayed distress call.
opportunities: Tracing the signal reveals a cache.
The false route bypasses a dangerous leg.
templates.reward: The crew identifies the deception and recovers useful routing intelligence.
templates.failure: The submarine loses time, fuel, and route position.
templates.persistent: The beacon's owner becomes a future faction or mystery lead.

templates.name: Sonar Shadow Corridor
templates.setup: Mineral layers swallow active sonar and distort passive returns.

stages.contact: Known landmarks disappear from the display.
stages.crisis: The submarine enters a blind corridor with narrowing clearance.
stages.aftermath: The crew must rebuild its position from partial readings.

complications: A moving contact hides inside the shadow.
The map is correct but vertically inverted.
Communications vanish with sonar.
opportunities: The shadow conceals an untouched route.
The mineral field can be commercially mapped.
templates.reward: The crew charts a reusable blind passage.
templates.failure: The vessel strikes terrain or exits far from the intended route.
templates.persistent: Mapped successfully, this corridor grants one future redraw here.

templates.name: Conflicting Charts
templates.setup: Two authoritative charts disagree about the same passage.

stages.crisis: Each chart places a lethal obstacle where the other shows open water.
stages.aftermath: The crew must document which source failed and why.

complications: One chart was altered deliberately.
Both charts are outdated.
The crew splits into rival interpretations.
opportunities: The bad chart identifies who benefits from the error.
templates.reward: The expedition establishes a dependable route record.
templates.failure: Indecision or a wrong choice adds delay and damage.
templates.persistent: The rejected chart remains evidence in a later sabotage or corruption investigation.

templates.name: Blocked Passage
templates.setup: Debris, ice, wreckage, or biological growth closes the expected route.

stages.crisis: The bypass proves narrower and more unstable than expected.
stages.aftermath: The crew must reopen, mark, or abandon the passage.

complications: The obstruction is under tension.
Something is nesting inside it.
Clearing it exposes a pressure pocket.
opportunities: The alternate route reaches an uncharted location.
templates.reward: The passage becomes usable and the crew retains control of the route.
templates.failure: The expedition spends resources and attracts additional danger.
templates.persistent: Uncleared, this edge remains dangerous on future crossings.
